name: Argon2 GUI
tagline: Hash and verify passwords with Argon2
blurb: Argon2 GUI is a minimal, user friendly graphical interface around the reference implementation of Argon2, the winner of the Password Hashing Competition.
description:
Argon2 GUI is a minimal, user friendly graphical interface around the reference
implementation of Argon2, the winner of the Password Hashing Competition.

It is handy during development and when testing or implementing web services
that deal with passwords. Features include:

• Hashing passwords with Argon2id, Argon2i or Argon2d

• Adjustable time cost, memory cost, parallelism and hash length

• Verifying a password against an encoded Argon2 hash

• Fully offline: the app has no network access

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
